test_cases.test_case: Enable Edit mode shows edit controls
preconditions: Dashboard has at least one block
test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard switches to Edit state: 'Reset page to default' button visible top-right; '+ Add a block' button visible below the Dashboard heading; each existing block shows move handle and three-dot options menu

test_cases.test_case: Disable Edit mode hides edit controls
test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard switches to View state: 'Reset page to default' and '+ Add a block' are not visible; move handles and three-dot options are not visible on blocks

test_cases.test_case: Attempt edit-only actions when Edit mode is off are blocked/invisible
preconditions: Dashboard in View state (Edit mode OFF)
steps: 2. Attempt to locate or click '+ Add a block' button
3. Attempt to click move handle on a block
4. Attempt to open three-dot options menu on a block
test_cases.expected_result: No edit-only UI elements are available: '+ Add a block' not visible; move handles and options menus are not visible and cannot be interacted with

test_cases.test_case: Open Add a block page from '+ Add a block' in Edit mode
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
test_cases.expected_result: Add a block page opens listing all available block types (Comments, Course overview, Latest announcements, Latest badges, Learning plans, Logged in user, Mentees, Online users, Private files, Random glossary entry, Recently accessed courses, Starred courses, Tags, Text, Upcoming events) and shows 'Add selected block' button and 'Cancel' link

test_cases.test_case: '+ Add a block' not available when Edit mode is off
preconditions: Dashboard in View state (Edit mode OFF)
steps: 2. Look for '+ Add a block' button below the Dashboard heading
test_cases.expected_result: '+ Add a block' button is not present in the UI and cannot be clicked

test_cases.test_case: Add a new block (Text) from Add a block page
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 3. Select 'Text' from the list of block types
test_cases.expected_result: The selected 'Text' block is added to the user's dashboard (visible in the Blocks container) and layout change persists for the current user (block remains after page reload)

test_cases.test_case: Cancel Add a block returns to Dashboard without changes
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 3. Click 'Cancel' link at the bottom of Add a block page
test_cases.expected_result: Returns to Dashboard view in Edit mode and no new block is added to the Blocks container

test_cases.test_case: Open Configure for a block from options menu
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. For a block, open the three-dot options menu
test_cases.expected_result: Block configuration UI opens for that block (configuration panel/modal/page is displayed)

test_cases.test_case: Delete a block from options menu
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. For a block, open the three-dot options menu
test_cases.expected_result: The block is removed from the Blocks container and the layout change persists for the current user (block remains removed after page reload)

test_cases.test_case: Initiate move via options menu 'Move' action
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. For a block, open the three-dot options menu
4. Complete the move as prompted by the UI (if move mode requires additional steps)
test_cases.expected_result: Move mode is initiated or block is reordered as appropriate and layout change persists for the current user

test_cases.test_case: Drag reorder blocks using move handle
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. Use move handle on a block to drag it to a new position within the Blocks container
test_cases.expected_result: Blocks reorder visually to reflect new order and layout change persists for the current user (order remains after page reload)

test_cases.test_case: Reset page to default reverts user layout
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. Click 'Reset page to default' button at top-right
3. Confirm reset if a confirmation is shown
test_cases.expected_result: Layout reverts to the default dashboard for the current user: any added/removed/reordered blocks are restored to default positions; change persists for the current user (after reload remains default)

test_cases.test_case: Layout changes persist across sessions for the same user
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 1. While logged in, add a 'Text' block and reorder blocks
2. Save changes implicitly (by UI persistence) and log out
3. Log back in as the same user and navigate to Dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: The added block and reordering persist and are visible after login (layout retained for the same user)

test_cases.test_case: Layout changes isolated per user (user B unaffected by user A changes)
preconditions: User A and User B have separate accounts
User A has modified their dashboard layout
steps: 1. Log in as User A and add or reorder blocks
3. Log in as User B and navigate to Dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: User B sees their own dashboard layout (no changes made by User A are visible to User B)

test_cases.test_case: Add the same block type twice
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 4. Repeat steps 2-3 to add another 'Text' block
test_cases.expected_result: Both 'Text' blocks are added to the Blocks container (duplicates allowed) and both persist for the current user

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a block without selecting a Block Type (validation)
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 3. Do NOT select any block type
test_cases.expected_result: Add action is blocked and a validation error is shown indicating 'Block Type' is required; no block is added to the Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Add a large number of blocks (scale test)
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 1. Repeat: Click '+ Add a block', select 'Text', click 'Add selected block' until 100 blocks have been added
2. Observe UI responsiveness and layout after additions
test_cases.expected_result: 100 blocks are added to the Blocks container; UI remains responsive and displays scroll/overflow as appropriate; layout changes persist for the current user

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to drag reorder when Edit mode is off fails
preconditions: Dashboard in View state (Edit mode OFF)
steps: 2. Attempt to drag a block by where the move handle would appear (move handle should not be visible)
test_cases.expected_result: No drag handle is present; user cannot start a drag reorder action; blocks remain in original order

test_cases.test_case: Delete all blocks until Blocks container is empty
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. For each block, open three-dot options and click 'Delete' until no blocks remain
test_cases.expected_result: All blocks are removed; Blocks container displays an empty state (no blocks visible); the empty layout persists for the current user after reload

test_cases.test_case: Click Reset when no changes made (no-op)
preconditions: Dashboard in Edit mode (Edit mode ON)
steps: 2. Click 'Reset page to default' button at top-right
test_cases.expected_result: Action completes with no visible layout changes (no-op) and dashboard remains in default layout; user remains on Dashboard in Edit mode
